en.quote: Having analyzed the sanctions against our space industry, I suggest that the United States use a trampoline to get its astronauts to the ISS.
en.head: An American spacecraft carried astronauts to the ISS.
en.body: On May 30, 2020, Crew Dragon launched from Florida with two astronauts. It was the first crewed launch from US soil on an American spacecraft in nine years. Musk later answered Rogozin’s joke by saying that the “trampoline is working.”

qsrc.t: RBC, report on Rogozin’s Twitter post
